text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The master of Zimbabwe's High Court has ordered the liquidator of a local company, WS Craser, to accept a Z$67 million bid for the firm by its former workers who have formed their own company.
- The creation of intensive protection zones for Zimbabwe's endangered black rhinos has reduced poaching of the animals with no reported incident in the past two years.
